description: This image is a section drawing titled "Diagram 2.34 Wall types 3.1 and 3.2 - internal concrete floor". The word "SECTION" appears in the bottom right corner. The diagram shows a horizontal concrete floor slab, rendered with a speckled aggregate pattern, crossing a single vertical wall section at right angles. The vertical wall section, which continues both above and below the floor slab, consists of a central band of rectangular blocks filled with a diagonal cross-hatch pattern, flanked on each side by a narrow strip showing a pattern of vertical lines bounded by parallel vertical lines. A leader line runs from a point on the floor slab to the right of the wall junction to a text box on the right side of the drawing. This label reads: "Concrete floor slab may be carried through if mass per unit area is at least 365kg/m²". No other dimensions or text are visible.
